name: Bernhard Riemann
summary: German mathematician and physicist known for contributions to analysis, geometry, and physical theory.

name: Carl Friedrich Gauss
summary: German mathematician and physicist who supervised Riemann at Göttingen.

name: Peter Gustav Lejeune Dirichlet
summary: German mathematician whose teaching influenced Riemann in Berlin.

name: Wilhelm Weber
summary: German physicist who collaborated with Riemann on electromagnetism.

name: Göttingen University
summary: German university where Riemann studied and later held a chair.

name: Berlin University
summary: German university where Riemann studied for one year.

name: Berlin Academy of Sciences
summary: Scientific academy to which Riemann was elected.

name: Kingdom of Hannover
summary: Historical kingdom where Riemann was born.

name: Lüneburg
summary: German town where Riemann attended gymnasium.

name: On the hypotheses that lie at the foundation of geometry
summary: Riemann's seminal lecture introducing n-dimensional manifold and curvature tensor.

name: On the number of primes less than a given magnitude
summary: Paper stating the Riemann hypothesis regarding the zeta function.

name: A contribution to Electrodynamics
summary: Posthumously published paper on unification of gravity, electricity, magnetism, and heat.

name: A contribution to the investigation of the movement of a uniform fluid ellipsoid
summary: Paper dealing with the movement of a uniform fluid ellipsoid under gravity.

name: About the propagation of plane airwaves of finite oscillation amplitude
summary: Paper integrating differential equations for gas movement.

name: About the distribution laws of electric tension in ponderable bodies
summary: Paper studying electric charge distribution in non-perfect conductors.

name: On the theory of noble color rings
summary: Experimental study of electrical current distribution producing color rings.
